dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Dear hedgehog, could you please tell me...

dialogues.speaker: Basement Dweller
dialogues.text: (The hedgehog remains motionless, curled up on the soft cushion.)

dialogues.speaker: Basement Dweller
dialogues.text: (It might be a sick hedgehog. A malicious hedgehog. An unremarkable hedgehog. Bitterly and futilely occupying a seat that does not belong to it.)

dialogues.speaker: Basement Dweller
dialogues.text: (This is not its seat, nor will it ever be. The cushion is dying, and the hedgehog knows it. That is why it despises itself — almost to the point of hatred.)

dialogues.speaker: Basement Dweller
dialogues.text: (Too much awareness is also a kind of illness. A true, complete illness.)
